hints.title: Locate the White Piece
hints.text: Scan the fixed 8x8 chessboard to identify the coordinates of the rook designated by the letter R.

hints.title: Ray Casting in Cardinal Directions
hints.text: From the rook position, extend rays upward, downward, leftward, and rightward step by step until hitting an obstruction or board boundary.

hints.title: Collision Detection
hints.text: If a step encounters a friendly bishop B, stop exploring that direction. If it encounters an enemy pawn p, increment the capture count by one and stop exploring that direction.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning every pair of cells without checking line of sight produces incorrect captures blocked by bishops.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Four directed ray marches inspect at most 28 squares, requiring constant time and auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should quickly find the rook and simulate 4-directional ray traversal with proper break conditions.
complexity.notes: Only pawns can be captured; bishops act as blocking obstacles.
